newsitem.title: USA: Arthur Andersen names Jim Wadia managing partner.
newsitem.headline: Arthur Andersen names Jim Wadia managing partner.

text.p: Arthur Andersen named Jim Wadia its new worldwide managing partner. Wadia is currently managing partner of Arthur Andersen's United Kingdom practice.
Wadia succeeds Richard L. Measelle, who retires from his leadership role after eight years as worldwide managing partner, effective Aug. 31, 1997.
Arthur Andersen is the world's leading multidisciplinary professional services firm.

Measelle is 58. Arthur Andersen partners have an informal policy that managers in the most senior posts, particularly worldwide managing partners, will begin to divest themselves of firmwide responsibilities after age 56 to keep career progression lines open for top performing younger partners.
Wadia, 49, was born in Bombay, educated in Switzerland and came to the United Kingdom in 1965. He joined Arthur Andersen in 1977 in the tax practice, became a manager in 1978 and a partner in 1982.

"My job will be to maintain that tradition of excellence and pull us even further ahead of our competition, while continuing to find creative ways to improve the business performance of our clients and offer challenging career opportunities for outstanding people," Wadia said in a statement.
